facts.text: 1. Loosen clamps (4) and (3) securing hose (1) to fuel tank (5) and to filler spout (2).
facts.quote: 1. Loosen clamps (4) and (3) securing hose (1) to fuel tank (5) and to filler spout (2).

facts.text: 1. Install hose (1) on filler spout (2) and slide on filler spout (2) until the hose (1) clears fuel tank (5).
facts.quote: 1. Install hose (1) on filler spout (2) and slide on filler spout (2) until the hose (1) clears fuel tank (5).

facts.text: 2. Slide hose (1) on to filler spout (2) until disconnected from fuel tank (5). Remove hose (1) from filler spout (2).
facts.quote: 2. Slide hose (1) on to filler spout (2) until disconnected from fuel tank (5). Remove hose (1) from filler spout (2).

facts.text: WARNING Diesel fuel is highly flammable. Do not perform this procedure near fire
